linkedin_searches.query_name: Telecom Channel Partner – Keywords + Primary Companies
linkedin_searches.reasoning: Covers profiles where people emphasize channel/partner/sales keywords instead of titles. Uses core telecom companies for maximum relevance.

linkedin_boolean_search.keywords: ("channel partner" OR "channel sales" OR "partner management" OR "distribution management" OR "indirect sales" OR "trade sales")
linkedin_boolean_search.company: ("Reliance Jio" OR "Airtel" OR "Bharti Airtel" OR "Vodafone Idea" OR "Vi" OR "BSNL")

linkedin_searches.expected_profiles: Managers and Assistant Managers using function keywords instead of exact channel titles.

linkedin_searches.query_name: Telecom Channel Partner – Job Titles + Primary Companies
linkedin_searches.reasoning: Captures candidates whose job titles align with channel/distribution structure but may not use strong keywords.

linkedin_boolean_search.job_title: ("Channel Manager" OR "Channel Sales Manager" OR "Partner Manager" OR "Distribution Manager" OR "Territory Sales Manager" OR "Area Sales Manager")
linkedin_boolean_search.company: ("Reliance Jio" OR "Airtel" OR "Vodafone Idea" OR "Vi" OR "Tata Communications" OR "TTBS")

linkedin_searches.expected_profiles: People with structured telecom sales org titles.

linkedin_searches.query_name: Telecom Channel Partner – Keywords + Extended Ecosystem
linkedin_searches.reasoning: Covers adjacent telecom ecosystem companies where channel/distribution talent exists: infra, fiber ISPs, OEMs.

linkedin_boolean_search.keywords: ("channel sales" OR "trade sales" OR "distribution" OR "indirect channel" OR "partner sales" OR "retail & channel")
linkedin_boolean_search.company: ("Indus Towers" OR "STL" OR "Tejas Networks" OR "GTPL" OR "ACT Fibernet" OR "RailTel")

search_strategy.reasoning: Telecom industry is narrow and well‑defined; company filter most reliably isolates target talent. Keywords supplement function; titles add specificity.
search_strategy.coverage_approach: Three-query structure: 1) Keywords + primary telecom companies, 2) Job titles + primary telecom companies, 3) Keywords + extended telecom ecosystem.

queryConstructorResult.coverage_assessment: Covers all major profile construction patterns: keyword-heavy telecom sales profiles, title-driven channel managers, and telecom-adjacent industry profiles. Ensures both primary and extended telecom ecosystems are reached while maintaining high precision through company filters.
